      "rating": { "attacker": "anyone", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "money" },

        { "quote": "Results are paged 500 at a time with no limit on how many pages a client can read." }
      ],

        "when": "the client requests more than the allowed number of pages or records in a time window",

      }
    },

      "component": "Public search API",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "anyone", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "availability" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Results are paged 500 at a time with no limit on how many pages a client can read." },
        { "quote": "the service turns the filter into a database query with string templates" }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-770"],
      "plainLanguage": "Someone can send a few very heavy searches and deep page requests and slow the database down until search stops working for everyone.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Bound the cost of a single public search query",
        "given": "a public search request with an arbitrary filter expression and page offset",
        "when": "the query is planned or executed",
        "then": "the service limits filter complexity (number of clauses and allowed operators), uses keyset paging instead of large offsets, applies a database query timeout and a per-client concurrency limit, and rejects requests that exceed them"
      }
    }
